extensionDescription.message: Enables incremental search for all dropdown (select) elements on any page.

popupTabUnavailable.message: The state cannot be determined for this tab.

popupUrlNotMatched.message: This page does not match an enabled URL pattern, so the feature is always disabled.

popupEnabled.message: This page matches an enabled URL and the toggle is ON, so the feature is enabled.

popupDisabled.message: This page matches an enabled URL, but the toggle is OFF, so the feature is disabled.

activeTabLoadError.message: Failed to get the active tab.

toggleSaveError.message: Failed to save the toggle setting.

optionsOpenError.message: Could not open the settings page.

urlDescription.message: Enable the extension only on pages matching the patterns below. Enter one pattern per line; * matches any text. Leave this empty to enable the extension on all URLs.

debugDescription.message: When enabled, select processing logs are written to the DevTools Console.

usageStep1.message: Add one URL pattern per line under Enabled URL settings (for example, https://example.com/*).

usageStep2.message: On a target page, click the extension icon and use the popup toggle to enable or disable the feature.

usageStep3.message: The toggle can be changed only on pages matching an enabled URL.

usageStep4.message: To inspect debug logs, enable DEBUG_LOG here and open the target page's DevTools Console.
